description:
Welcome to Tarzana! This centrally located unit offers convenient access to nearby shopping and dining. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms and 2 parking spaces! this home includes a private entry gate and access to a community pool. The updated kitchen boasts granite countertops, newly refinished cabinets, and stainless steel appliances.

Enjoy tile flooring throughout, fresh interior paint, central A/C and heat, and recessed lighting. A sliding glass door opens to your own private balcony, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The primary bathroom showcases a modern design with a quartz countertop and a recently renovated walk-in shower with stylish tile finishes. The second bathroom includes a shower-tub combination for added convenience.
